route_found.name: SFCC SFRA Product-Variation endpoint (Demandware native, no auth, no Apify)
route_found.note_colorCount_field: UNRELIABLE - do not use. Observed: NB 574 colorCount=1 with 2 color values; ABZORB 2000 colorCount=3 with 4 values; Skull Hoodie colorCount=2 with 2 values. Count the color attribute's values array instead.
route_found.returns: JSON: product.variationAttributes[] with attributeId 'color' (values: id/value = style code, displayValue = color name, selected, selectable, accessible, isOnSale, per-color Product-Variation URL, images.swatch[] full image set per color) and attributeId 'size' (values with per-size selectable flags); product.price (group sales/list); product.images per selected color.
